balance.title: Balance
balance.description:
This is the net value of your account in euros as of the quote date shown above.

It is calculated as:
Portfolio − Leverage

In other words: the market value of all open positions (converted to EUR with today’s USD→EUR rate), minus the leverage / debit balance you configured under Configuration.

If leverage is 0 €, Balance equals Portfolio.

It does not include cash in the account or P/L from already closed trades — only the net value of the open book after subtracting borrowed capital.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description:
This is the gross market value of all open positions, in euros.

Per position:
D‑1 closing price × quantity

Each position is converted to EUR with today’s stored USD→EUR rate (open.er-api), then all positions are summed.

Only ISINs with non-zero net quantity (open holdings) are included. Leverage is not subtracted here — see Balance for that.

Prices use the date in the «Data as of» block (latest available market close relative to yesterday UTC, with lookback when the market was closed).

leverage.title: Leverage
leverage.description:
This is the borrowed capital / debit balance you entered under Configuration, in euros.

It is not pulled automatically from Degiro: each time you save an amount, a new history row is stored (user_leverages) with a timestamp, and this figure uses the latest value.

It is shown in grey as contextual data; its main effect is on Balance (Portfolio − Leverage).

If you never set leverage, it is 0 €.

day.title: Day
day.description:
This is the one-day (D‑1) change of the whole open portfolio, in euros.

Per position:
1) Take the closing price for the date shown and the previous trading day’s close (same provider).
2) Per-share change = current close − previous close.
3) Position change = per-share change × quantity.
4) Convert to EUR with today’s USD→EUR rate and sum across all positions.

Green = open book gained value that day; red = it lost value. This is not realized or lifetime P/L — only the price move between two available consecutive closes.

totalPl.title: Total P/L
totalPl.description:
This is your total accumulated profit or loss in euros, combining open and closed activity.

Total P/L = unrealized P/L (open positions) + realized P/L (fully closed trades)

Unrealized P/L (per open ISIN):
current market value − average cost of the remaining open lot
(cost is walked from buys/sells with average-cost on sells, then converted to EUR).

Realized P/L:
sum of results for ISINs whose net quantity is 0 (same basis as the Summary / trades-summary tab), using Degiro’s SUM(value) in the base currency; if that currency is USD it is converted to EUR.

Note: partial sells on a position that is still open are not counted as «realized» in Summary; their effect is absorbed into the average cost of what remains open.

Green = net accumulated profit; red = net accumulated loss.
